newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century jumps for third day in row.
newsitem.headline: India Century jumps for third day in row.

text.p: Shares of Century Textiles and Industries Ltd jumped for the third straight day on Wednesday after the company said it will consider a bonus equity issue on May 6, brokers said.
The share rose 115.25 rupees, or 5.0 percent, to 2,420.15 on the National Stock Exchange in early trade, after rising by 5.0 percent on each of the previous two days.
Trading on the Bombay exchange was delayed on Wednesday due to a technical problem. The share had risen six percent on Tuesday after rising 10 percent on Monday.
The company said on Monday its board will also finalise accounts and recommend dividend for the year ended March 31, 1997 at the same meeting.
The board will also consider a ten-for-one stock split, which envisages sub-dividing the 100-rupee face value stock into 10-rupee shares, the firm had said.
